prompt_unchanged.pre_w3: The IDOHO capital inventory in the Capital Portfolio Studio (money in million USD; NPV percentiles are success-case outcomes, P90 the low case): ID-1 Infill wells: capex 145, NPV P50 118.4, P10 176.2, P90 71.5, chance of success 0.92, loss if it fails 14.6; ID-2 Compression upgrade: capex 215, NPV P50 163.7, P10 241.9, P90 102.3, chance of success 0.86, loss if it fails 23.8; ID-3 Near-field exploration: capex 105, NPV P50 388.5, P10 655.4, P90 198.7, chance of success 0.3, loss if it fails 72.4; ID-4 Water injection: capex 265, NPV P50 231.9, P10 338.6, P90 141.2, chance of success 0.78, loss if it fails 46.3; ID-5 Well interventions: capex 75, NPV P50 47.3, P10 63.8, P90 31.6, chance of success 0.97, loss if it fails 5.1; ID-6 Subsea tie-back: capex 340, NPV P50 402.6, P10 611.3, P90 224.8, chance of success 0.5, loss if it fails 131.5; ID-7 Flare recovery: capex 190, NPV P50 121.2, P10 170.4, P90 79.9, chance of success 0.88, loss if it fails 18.7. Capex limits of 520, 640 and 900. The IDOHO-2 well AFE in the AFE Cost Control Manager, in USD, window 2028-03-06 to 2029-01-19, read as of 2028-10-03: RIG-01 Rig and drilling services: budget 11384650, commitment 1937400, actual 8215730, no entered forecast, progress 67.5 percent; TUB-02 Casing and tubulars: budget 2963180, commitment 0, actual 3148920, no entered forecast, progress 100 percent; CEM-03 Cementing: budget 1476325, commitment 412600, actual 688140, entered forecast 1591870, progress 48 percent; EVL-04 Evaluation and testing: budget 3208470, commitment 1265300, actual 1418260, no entered forecast, progress 37.5 percent; CPL-05 Completion: budget 4719850, commitment 873900, actual 0, no entered forecast, progress 0 percent. Joint venture partners on IDOHO-2: Asabo Oil 37.25 percent, Okwori Energy 18.6 percent, Ebok Resources 9.15 percent; the operator carries the rest. Bill the actuals to date by working interest. Portfolio risk uses the engine default seed and iterations; where an average correlation is stated it is 0.45. Read six values. Portfolio money to four decimals in million USD; the probability to four decimals; USD to the nearest unit.
